note: Incremental monitor (scripts/discover.py --monitor). Nex runs one tick every tick_minutes; each tick scans the tiers that are due. Frequencies, look-back, politeness and alert thresholds live here, not in code. Phase 0 of docs/briefing-monitor-design.md in the Nex repository: no model is called.

deadline.note: From boost_hours_before a case deadline until watch_after_hours after it, the case's watch_sources are checked every interval_minutes. After the deadline, once each watched source has been checked, one alert says what was or was not listed.
